bandReport.notes:
BOUNDARIES. Item 51 begins at the very top of p10 c1 (printed page 21) — nothing opens mid-item, so page 9's owner should be ending on item 50. Item 67 completes in full at the foot of p13 c2 (printed page 27), option (d) printed whole above the '[ P.T.O.' footer — nothing continues onto page 14. Numbers run 51..67 with no skips and no repeats. Page layout throughout: c1 then c2, two items per column on pages 10-12, and 2 + 3 on page 13.

CROPS. All eight column crops were legible and no page had to be read from pNN.png. The c2 crop on every one of the four pages carries a narrow sliver of column 1's right-hand edge down its left margin (isolated fragment letters such as 'n', 'al', 'or'). That is bleed from the neighbour, not a slice of c2 itself: no c2 line is cut, every item number is present at the top of c2, and no c1 text was absorbed into a c2 item. Verified against the whole-page images.

END-OF-LINE HYPHENS REJOINED (justified typesetting, wrap hyphens, not printed hyphens): item 52 'child-' / 'birth' -> childbirth; item 54 'smart-' / 'phone' -> smartphone; item 67 'thermo-' / 'chemical' -> thermochemical. All other hyphens in this band fall within a single printed line (non-nutritional, pre-school, jet-propelled, medium-range, solid-fuelled, coal-based, above-mentioned, water-stressed, two-thirds) and are genuine, so they are kept.

PRINTED ODDITY, TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM. Item 66 statement 2 prints 'None of them is set up in water-stressed district.' — no article before 'water-stressed'. That is what the booklet prints; it has not been corrected.

ITEM 56 is printed as a genuine two-column grid with the column headings 'Objects in space' and 'Description' set above it, so it is rendered as a pipe table with those headings and the printed item numbers kept in the left column.

STATEMENT-I / STATEMENT-II items (63, 64) print the label with an en dash ('Statement–I'); transcribed with a plain hyphen. Content unaffected.

NO DEFECTS OF THE EXPENSIVE KIND FOUND: every one of the 17 items has exactly four options, none blank, none duplicated, and no stem is garbled or truncated.

SUBTOPIC WARNING (soft, one item): item 59 (mercury pollution) has no listed subtopic that fits — the Environmental Pollution subtopics are air / water / solid-waste / noise-soil-thermal / bioremediation, and heavy-metal contamination is none of these. Used the short label 'Heavy Metal Pollution'; a catalog extension candidate.

questions.stem:
Consider the following statements in relation to Janani Suraksha Yojana :

4. Its objective includes providing public health facilities to sick infants up to one year of age.
